entry.title: Orbit Meet live captions are now generally available in 12 languages
entry.summary: Live captions in Orbit Meet are now generally available on the Business Standard and Business Plus plans, in 12 languages. Admins can turn captions on per organizational unit. No extra license is required.

entry.title: Orbit Mail will stop accepting basic authentication for IMAP and POP
entry.summary: Starting January 15, 2027, Orbit Mail rejects IMAP and POP sign-ins that use a password alone. Mail clients must use OAuth. Older scanners and line-of-business apps that send mail with basic authentication will stop working. A report of affected sign-ins is available in the admin console under Reports > Legacy sign-ins.

entry.title: Orbit Drive Business price change
entry.summary: The Orbit Drive Business plan moves from $12.00 to $14.00 per user per month for monthly billing on February 1, 2027. Annual commitments renew at the new price after that date.
